answer: One credential is a lock a farm can pick; a ferrous gate needs two keys from different worlds. The rule is crystal-clear: every identity must present two independent proofs, one government credential and one financial-history proof, each verified by a separate registrar that stores only a hash. If either proof is revoked, the identity freezes and its earnings are held. Forging one credential costs about $30, the other about $50, so 10,000 shells cost $800,000 plus a fraud charge per forgery, while the reward pool stops being an oasis for farms that can only fake one side.
